application_credentials.description: Create a project in the [Kia Developers console]({console_url}). Register `{callback_url}` as the Account API Redirect URL. `{consent_callback_url}` is needed as the Data API Redirect URL only when Kia requires a separate data-sharing agreement. If the displayed address differs from the externally reachable Home Assistant URL, correct Home Assistant's external URL setting before continuing.

vehicles.title: Choose vehicles
vehicles.description: Select every Kia vehicle to add to Home Assistant. Only vehicles authorized during Kia login are shown.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Kia Vehicle KR
reauth_confirm.description: Kia no longer accepts the saved authorization. Continue to sign in again.

consent.title: Approve Kia data sharing
consent.description: Continue in the Kia window to approve third-party personal-data sharing.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve vehicles from Kia. Confirm data-sharing consent and try again.
error.invalid_vehicle: One or more selected vehicles are no longer available.

abort.cannot_connect: Unable to verify the Kia account during reauthentication. Try again later.
abort.no_vehicles: Kia returned no authorized vehicles. Confirm vehicle access and third-party data-sharing consent in Kia Developers.
abort.consent_failed: Kia's data-sharing consent page could not be opened. Verify the Data API Redirect URL in Kia Developers.
abort.invalid_consent_callback: Kia returned an invalid or expired data-sharing consent result.

init.title: Configure Kia Vehicle KR
init.description: Choose the vehicles to expose and how often Home Assistant requests fresh data.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve vehicles from Kia. Try again later.
